reason: The hypothesis proposes adding Re to HfMoNbTaW to alter the Peierls barrier of screw dislocations, an idea not present in any passage. While the mechanism of a screw-to-edge transition and plateau strength is directly taken from P32 and related papers, the specific intervention (Re doping) and its link to electronic structure modification of dislocation cores are new. However, the core idea of manipulating the slip transition to improve high-temperature strength is a direct restatement of the mechanism and future directions implied by P32, P20, and P25, making the overall concept largely copied.
